articles.titleCn: 匹配结果，分歧视线：聚焦式MLLM搜索与人类的对比
articles.abstractCn: 人类视觉搜索是序列性的：只有当视锥细胞落在候选目标上才能确认它，这些落点形成了扫描路径。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在接收到相同的视锥细胞聚焦输入时，是否像人类一样进行搜索，这关系到它们作为人类视觉模型的有效性，也影响着注意力对齐分数。我们通过目标导向搜索（COCO-Search18）将三种通用型MLLM与人类眼动扫描路径进行比较，通过相同的、与人类匹配的视锥细胞聚焦视图逐点驱动每个模型的注视，并在三个维度上评估它们：目标存在与否的决策、达到目标的效率以及注视过程本身。这三个维度是相互独立的。在决策和目标获取方面，模型与人类相当甚至超越人类，检测到存在目标的准确率接近完美，并且在第一次扫视中就到达目标的比例高于人类。但注视过程并非人类模式。在人类匹配条件下，这三种模型都共享一个特征：低熵、大振幅、自洽的扫描路径，这些路径彼此之间的一致性远高于两个人类之间的一致性。这与单次通过、非序列性架构更为一致，而非视力敏锐度的限制。匹配的视网膜输入能够复现人类注视的位置，但无法复现人类在时间维度上的注视过程，并且没有退化机制能够在类似人类的成功率下恢复类似人类的搜索。这个差距存在于一个被答案对齐和显著性指标所忽略的过程维度上。由于它们忽略了这一点，这些指标无法认证类似人类的视觉，零样本模型适用于结果和空间问题，但不适用于时间维度和过程层面的问题。

articles.title: Computational KJ-Ho: An Analyst-Bias-Free Insight Extraction Framework from Large-Scale Qualitative Data Using Domain-Specialized LLMs
articles.abstract: The qualitative research methodologies that underpin consumer-insight generation - the KJ method, Grounded Theory, and Thematic Analysis - share a structural constraint: the cognitive processing capacity of the human analyst. Replication research further shows that conclusions vary substantially across analysts analyzing identical data (analyst bias). This paper proposes Computational KJ-Ho (the Kawakita Jiro method), a theoretical framework that computationally realizes the KJ method's epistemology - letting structure emerge from the data itself without imposing the analyst's preconceptions - an orientation we term "analyst-bias-free." The framework employs a domain-specialized LLM built through continued pre-training (CPT) on a marketing-research corpus and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert-curated insight pairs, organized as a three-layer architecture: data structuring, insight extraction, and strategy generation. Two preliminary studies in the Japanese marketing context support the necessity of CPT-based domain specialization. The paper makes five contributions: (1) a theoretical integration of the KJ method, Grounded Theory, and Peircean abduction into a single epistemological commitment of data-driven explanation generation; (2) a three-layer architecture leveraging domain-specialized embeddings for cross-interview analysis; (3) two novel evaluation metrics, InsightExtraction-F1 and MarketingQA; (4) explicit engagement with the WEIRD problem, centering a non-Western methodology; and (5) five practice-derived problem formulations from nearly three decades of marketing-research practice, translated into design requirements. The human analyst retains a supervisory role. This is a concept paper presented ahead of empirical validation.
articles.titleCn: 计算式KJ-Ho：基于领域专用大型语言模型的大规模定性数据分析框架
articles.abstractCn: 支撑消费者洞察生成的定性研究方法——KJ方法、扎根理论和主题分析法——都存在一个结构性约束：人类分析员的认知处理能力。复制研究进一步表明，分析相同数据的分析员得出的结论存在显著差异（分析员偏见）。本文提出了计算型KJ-Ho（川北二郎方法），这是一个理论框架，通过计算实现KJ方法的认知论——让结构从数据本身中涌现，而不强加分析员的先入观念——我们称之为“无分析员偏见”的取向。该框架采用一个领域专业的大型语言模型，通过在营销研究语料库上持续预训练（CPT）和在专家编辑的洞察对上实施监督微调（SFT）构建而成，并组织为三层架构：数据结构化、洞察提取和策略生成。在日本营销背景下的两项初步研究支持了基于CPT的领域专业化的必要性。本文提出了五项贡献：（1）将KJ方法、扎根理论和皮尔斯的溯因法整合为单一的数据驱动解释生成认知论承诺；（2）采用领域专业嵌入的三层架构进行跨访谈分析；（3）提出两种新的评估指标，洞察提取F1和营销问答；（4）明确探讨WEIRD问题，以非西方方法为中心；（5）将近三十年营销研究实践推导出的五个实践问题转化为设计需求。人类分析员仍保留监督角色。这是一篇在实证验证之前呈现的概念性论文。

articles.title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a key technique for visually rich long document understanding. Existing multi-modal RAG methods are progressively advancing toward multi-agent systems: they first retrieve relevant pages based on a query, and then iteratively understand information within those pages. However, these methods typically rely on fixed workflows and lack the ability to dynamically scale computation at test time, often leading to insufficient evidence. To address this, we propose D2-ScaleAgent, an agentic framework that introduces a dual-dimensional scaling paradigm for retrieval and reasoning. The core of D2-ScaleAgent is a Verifier agent-driven dynamic routing loop based on the intrinsic difficulty of the query, centered around a continuously updated evidence bank that serves as the agent's dynamic working memory: when retrieval needs to be expanded, the agent routes outward (retrieval scaling), decomposing the query into attributes and performing parallel page retrieval, followed by adaptive pruning to ensure comprehensive evidence coverage. When fine-grained reasoning is required, the agent routes inward (reasoning scaling), dynamically selecting sub-agents with varying granularity and count to extract evidence from pages. Finally, D2-ScaleAgent achieves logical closure over the evidence chain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D2-ScaleAgent is effective on long and visually rich document benchmarks like MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, etc.
articles.titleCn: D2-ScaleAgent：用于长文档理解的二维缩放方法
articles.abstractCn: 多模态检索增强生成（RAG）是视觉丰富长文档理解的关键技术。现有的多模态RAG方法正逐步向多智能体系统发展：它们首先根据查询检索相关页面，然后迭代理解这些页面中的信息。然而，这些方法通常依赖固定的工作流程，缺乏在测试时动态扩展计算的能力，往往导致证据不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了D2-ScaleAgent，一个引入了检索和推理双重维度扩展范式的智能体框架。D2-ScaleAgent的核心是一个基于查询内在难度的验证智能体驱动的动态路由循环，围绕一个持续更新的证据库作为智能体的动态工作内存：当需要扩展检索时，智能体向外路由（检索扩展），将查询分解为属性并执行并行页面检索，随后进行自适应剪枝以确保全面的证据覆盖；当需要细粒度推理时，智能体向内路由（推理扩展），动态选择不同粒度和数量的子智能体从页面中提取证据。最终，D2-ScaleAgent在证据链上实现了逻辑闭合。大量实验表明，D2-ScaleAgent在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL等长且视觉丰富的文档基准测试中表现有效。

articles.title: Counting Documents Is Not Counting Text: Unit Bias in Web-PDF Corpus Statistics
articles.abstract: PDF corpora advertise their size in tokens but compute every rate they publish (coverage, OCR routing, re-fetch recovery, language mix) per document, and none decomposes its token total. The two units diverge sharply. On CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED (7.9M web PDFs, 32.6B tokens), 3.02% of text-bearing documents hold half the tokens (Gini 0.807); documents over 50 pages are 5.00% of the corpus but 53.53% of its text. The PDFs produced by a TeX{} toolchain are 1.66% of documents and 4.05% of the text. The clearest casualty is Common Crawl's truncation cap: it affected 23.06% of documents and 63.08% of the text. Reconstructing the truncated files and extracting both versions, two widely used libraries recover 11.4% and 1.4% of that text; between 72% and 97% of affected documents yield nothing; roughly 55--62% of the corpus's text is lost. Under the 5 MiB cap adopted in March 2025, 30.19% of tokens would still be truncated, and recovery on those documents rises only from 3.3% to 13.2%. We recommend that corpus statistics be reported in both units: documents and tokens.
articles.titleCn: 统计文档并非统计文本：网络PDF语料库统计中的单元偏差
articles.abstractCn: PDF语料库通常以token数量宣传其规模，但计算其发布的所有比率（覆盖率、OCR路由、重新获取恢复、语言混合）都是基于每份文档，并且没有任何语料库会分解其token总数。这两个单位之间存在显著差异。在CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED（790万份网络PDF，326亿个token）中，3.02%的含文本文档包含了一半的token（基尼系数0.807）；超过50页的文档占语料库的5.00%，但占其文本的53.53%。由TeX工具链生成的PDF文档占文档的1.66%，占文本的4.05%。最明显的损失是Common Crawl的截断限制：它影响了23.06%的文档和63.08%的文本。重建截断文件并提取两个版本后，两种广泛使用的库仅恢复11.4%和1.4%的文本；受影响的72%至97%的文档什么也恢复不了；语料库中大约55%至62%的文本丢失。在2025年3月采用的5 MiB限制下，30.19%的token仍将被截断，而这些文档的恢复率仅从3.3%提高到13.2%。我们建议语料库统计数据应以文档数和token数两种单位报告。

articles.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
articles.abstract: Financial agents must do more than recall domain knowledge: they must be both reliable, executing precise operations over grounded evidence, and executive, sustaining long-horizon research whose conclusions remain auditable. We present Mint-Agent, a family of finance-native agentic models designed around these two scales of financial intelligence. Mint-Agent is built upon three pillars: data, harness, and algorithm. Our data engine constructs clean, specialized tasks for atomic financial capabilities and long-horizon agentic execution from real-world financial sources. MintHarness enables stable interaction with open-ended environments and maintains auditable evidence trails across extended research trajectories. Our training recipe combines SFT, critical-step OPD, and RLVR to develop separate financial reasoning and agentic execution experts, which are then unified through model merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation into compact, general-purpose financial agents. This pipeline yields two flagship models, Mint-Cu (9B) and Mint-Ag (27B). Across professional financial benchmarks, our models demonstrate two defining strengths: (1) Reliability: Mint-Ag achieves 98.33% on RFC-Bench, surpassing GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-4.8 by 3.66 and 3.00 points; and (2) Executability: Mint-Cu reaches 69.86% on FinSearchComp T2, outperforming Agents-A1-35B and Nex-N2-mini by 22.83 and 12.78 points, while Mint-Ag achieves 76.00% and 60.49% on FinanceAgentBench v1.1 and v2, respectively. These results establish a path toward trustworthy financial intelligence in which domain expertise, long-horizon execution, and auditable evidence are jointly engineered as a unified foundation for frontier agentic models.
articles.titleCn: Mint-Agent：介绍金融原生智能代理基础模型
articles.abstractCn: 金融代理必须超越单纯调用领域知识：它们必须兼具可靠性与执行力。可靠性体现在基于可靠证据执行精确操作，执行力则要求持续进行长时程研究，且其结论需保持可审计性。我们提出了 Mint-Agent，这是一系列围绕金融智能双重维度设计的金融原生代理模型。Mint-Agent 建立在三大支柱之上：数据、驾驭工具（Harness）和算法。我们的数据引擎从真实金融数据源构建清洁、专业的原子金融能力任务及长时程代理执行任务。MintHarness 实现与开放式环境的稳定交互，并在扩展研究轨迹中维持可审计的证据追踪。我们的训练方案结合了监督微调（SFT）、关键步骤输出对齐（OPD）和强化学习视觉推理（RLVR），以培养独立的金融推理与代理执行专家，随后通过模型融合和多导师策略蒸馏将它们统一为紧凑型通用金融代理。该流程产生了 Mint-Cu（9B）和 Mint-Ag（27B）两大旗舰模型。在专业金融基准测试中，我们的模型展现出两大核心优势：（1）可靠性：Mint-Ag 在 RFC-Bench 上达到 98.33%，较 GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-4.8 分别领先 3.66 和 3.00 个百分点；（2）执行力：Mint-Cu 在 FinSearchComp T2 上取得 69.86%，较 Agents-A1-35B 和 Nex-N2-mini 分别领先 22.83 和 12.78 个百分点，而 Mint-Ag 在 FinanceAgentBench v1.1 和 v2 上分别达到 76.00% 和 60.49%。这些成果为构建可信金融智能铺平了道路，将领域专业知识、长时程执行能力和可审计证据共同设计为前沿代理模型统一的基础。

articles.title: Unadapted Multilingual ASR on a Garrusi Kurdish Evaluation Set: A Common-Reference Staged Normalization Analysis
articles.abstract: Evaluating speech recognition for a Kurdish variety written in a Latin field orthography, using a model that outputs Arabic script, creates a measurement problem before a modelling one: direct scoring treats writing-system differences as recognition errors. Jointly normalizing reference and hypothesis avoids this, but also changes reference tokenization, mixing agreement gains with a change in the scoring denominator. I evaluate MMS-1B-all with the Central Kurdish (ckb) adapter, used as released without adaptation, on 1,722 Garrusi questionnaire segments from five speakers (9,763 reference word tokens; 117.9 minutes). I use a common-reference design: the reference is folded once and fixed at 9,763 tokens, while only the hypothesis representation varies. The raw Arabic-script hypothesis scores 111.70% WER and 100.92% CER, with zero exact word matches. Latin transliteration gives 102.36% WER and 57.89% CER; folding it into the reference's reduced orthography gives 97.85% and 51.20%. Thus RAW-to-FOLDED reduces measured WER by 13.85 points and CER by 49.72 points; folding alone accounts for 4.51 and 6.69 points. Substantial error remains: 14.53% of reference tokens are exact matches, edits are substitution-dominated, and per-segment WER is higher for shorter segments. A Southern Kurdish fine-tuned system (aranemini/southern-kurdish-asr), scored under the same design, performs worse on every speaker (1,703 segments), with 109.56% WER and 55.85% CER. However, 12,330 output characters fall outside the folding table, so these rates must be recomputed against the corrected fixed reference. The MMS output also contains 613 unconverted or unmapped characters, showing that part of the residual error reflects scoring-pipeline limits rather than recognition alone. I will release the fixed reference and segment-level results, subject to source-corpus sharing terms, to support independent checking.
articles.comment: 12 pages A4, 4 tables, 2 figures, pilot study
articles.titleCn: 在Garrusi库尔德语评估集上的未适配多语言语音识别：基于公共参考的阶段性标准化分析
articles.abstractCn: 评估使用拉丁字母正字法书写的库尔德语方言的语音识别，并采用输出阿拉伯字母的模型，会引发一个测量问题，而非建模问题：直接评分将书写系统差异视为识别错误。联合规范化参考文本和假设文本可以避免这个问题，但也改变了参考文本的分词方式，将一致性收益与评分分母的变化混淆在一起。我使用MMS-1B-all模型与中央库尔德语（ckb）适配器进行评估，该适配器未经适配直接使用，在来自五名说话人的1,722个Garrusi问卷片段上（9,763个参考词标记；117.9分钟）。我采用共同参考设计：参考文本折叠一次并固定为9,763个标记，而假设文本表示仅变化。原始阿拉伯字母假设文本评分为111.70% WER和100.92% CER，没有完全匹配的单词。拉丁字母转写评分为102.36% WER和57.89% CER；将其折叠到参考文本的简化正字法中评分为97.85%和51.20%。因此，RAW到FOLDED将测量WER降低了13.85分，CER降低了49.72分；仅折叠降低了4.51分和6.69分。仍存在大量错误：14.53%的参考标记完全匹配，编辑以替换为主，且每段WER在较短的片段中更高。一个经过微调的南部库尔德语系统（aranemini/southern-kurdish-asr），在相同设计下评分，在所有说话人（1,703个片段）上的表现更差，WER为109.56%，CER为55.85%。然而，12,330个输出字符超出折叠表，因此这些比率必须针对修正后的固定参考文本重新计算。MMS输出还包含613个未转换或未映射的字符，表明部分残余错误反映了评分流程的限制，而不仅仅是识别问题。我将根据源语料库共享条款发布固定参考文本和片段级结果，以支持独立核查。

articles.title: HalluTracer: Hallucination Detection via Depth-Averaging Truth Signals
articles.abstract: Even well-aligned large language models confidently generate factually incorrect text, making hallucination a persistent reliability risk in high-stakes deployments. These models nonetheless carry linearly separable truthfulness signals in their internal representations. Existing white-box detectors, however, collapse this evidence to isolated components or a single depth, discarding discriminative information distributed across the full forward pass. We introduce HalluTracer, a detection framework that reads and aggregates truthfulness evidence across every layer of the forward pass before the model emits any answer token. A geometric analysis reveals that the per-layer signals are weakly correlated, so that simple depth averaging suppresses layer-specific noise and captures nearly all linearly accessible information. Across six open-source language models and five hallucination benchmarks, HalluTracer consistently outperforms matched white-box baselines, with gains ranging from one to fourteen points. Collectively, our work recasts hallucination detection from a layer-selection problem into a depth-aggregation problem governed by the geometric sparsity of the truthfulness signal.
articles.titleCn: HalluTracer：基于深度平均真实信号进行幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 即使是高度对齐的大型语言模型也会自信地生成事实性错误文本，使得幻觉成为高风险部署中的持续性可靠性风险。然而，这些模型在其内部表示中携带了线性可分性的真实性信号。然而，现有的白盒检测器将这种证据简化为孤立组件或单一深度，丢弃了在全前向传递中分布的判别信息。我们引入了HalluTracer，这是一个检测框架，它在模型发出任何答案标记之前，读取并聚合前向传递中每一层的真实性证据。几何分析表明，每层信号弱相关，因此简单的深度平均可以抑制层特定噪声并捕获几乎所有线性可访问信息。在六个开源语言模型和五个幻觉基准测试中，HalluTracer始终优于匹配的白盒基线，提升幅度从1到14个百分点不等。总体而言，我们的工作将幻觉检测问题从层选择问题重新定义为受真实性信号几何稀疏性约束的深度聚合问题。

articles.title: Architecture-Dependent Causal Transfer of Activation States Across Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Direct communication between AI systems relies on natural language as an intermediate layer, incurring encoding/decoding overhead, token cost, and latency. We ask whether internal activation states can instead be transferred causally between different large language model (LLM) architectures via a learned projection, evaluated at three levels: representational similarity, cross-model retrieval from projected states, and end-to-end causal transfer via activation injection during generation. Using four architecturally diverse open-weight models (Qwen2-0.5B, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, FLAN-T5-base), we find that representational alignment in trained models exceeds a random-initialization null baseline and is best captured by a rank-based metric (mutual k-nearest-neighbour alignment), more robust to activation-magnitude outliers than centered kernel alignment (CKA) or Procrustes analysis. A learned projection network retrieves the correct target-model representation from a held-out set well above chance for the three causal decoder-only model pairs (45-50% top-1 accuracy vs. 5% chance) but at chance level for the encoder-based FLAN-T5. Injecting projected activations into a target model during generation produces a statistically significant, pre-registered causal effect on retrieval-based output similarity for only one of the three decoder-only pairs (Qwen2-0.5B to Phi-3-mini: 23.3% vs. 0.0% under negative control, p=0.047, FDR-corrected); the two pairs targeting Mistral-7B show no such effect despite comparable representational alignment at the hidden-state level. We interpret these results as evidence for causal transfer of the representational vehicle, not of meaning, and conclude that end-to-end activation-state transfer between LLMs, as currently implemented, is architecture-dependent rather than universal.
articles.titleCn: 跨大型语言模型的架构依赖激活状态因果传递
articles.abstractCn: AI系统之间的直接通信依赖于自然语言作为中间层，这带来了编码/解码开销、token成本和延迟。我们探究是否可以通过学习到的投影，在大型语言模型（LLM）的不同架构之间因果地传递内部激活状态，并在三个层次上进行评估：表征相似性、从投影状态进行跨模型检索，以及通过在生成过程中注入激活进行端到端因果传递。使用四个架构各异的开放权重模型（Qwen2-0.5B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、FLAN-T5-base），我们发现训练模型的表征对齐超过了随机初始化的基线，并且最佳地由基于秩的度量（互k近邻对齐）捕捉，该度量比中心核对齐（CKA）或Procrustes分析对激活幅度异常值更鲁棒。学习到的投影网络从保留集中检索目标模型的正确表征，对于三个因果解码器模型对（45-50%的top-1准确率对比5%的随机概率）表现远超偶然，但对于基于编码器的FLAN-T5则处于随机水平。在生成过程中向目标模型注入投影激活，仅对其中之一的三个解码器模型对（Qwen2-0.5B到Phi-3-mini：23.3%对比0.0%的负控制，p=0.047，FDR校正后）产生了统计上显著的、预先注册的因果效应，而针对Mistral-7B的两个模型对尽管在隐藏状态层面的表征对齐相当，却未显示出此类效应。我们将这些结果解释为表征载体而非意义的因果传递的证据，并得出结论：当前实现的LLM之间的端到端激活状态传递是架构依赖的而非普遍的。

articles.title: IndicQE-APE: A Benchmark for Quality Estimation and Automatic Post-Editing for Indic Languages
articles.abstract: Indic quality estimation (QE) and automatic post-editing (APE) data is spread across separate releases, so no single resource supports training and evaluation across tasks and language pairs on one footing. We consolidate the WMT 2020--2024 shared-task lineage with an extended English--Malayalam resource into \indicqe: $126{,}754$ instances over nine directional pairs, with up to four label types aligned on the same segment, a direct assessment, a human post-edit, word-level OK/BAD tags and an error explanation, and a test set stratified over four difficulty axes. On it, we benchmark six prompted LLMs and three COMET metrics on segment-level QE, and three systems on APE. Two of the axes are defined partly on the direct assessment and select a compressed slice of it, so each axis is compared against a control drawn from the same language pair with the same score distribution. Only one survives that control: segments whose holistic and token-level quality signals conflict are ranked worse than equally-scored segments of the same language, for all nine systems and all seven pairs that carry the axis. Annotator disagreement, which looks second-hardest without the control, has no effect with it. Few-shot prompting costs every model $\leq$ $3.4$B both correlation and output-format compliance. Within-language accuracy does not make scores comparable across pairs: of the three trained metrics, the one with the best within-language correlation loses most when the pairs are pooled. The benchmark and code will be released.
articles.titleCn: IndicQE-APE：印地语质量评估和自动后期编辑的基准
articles.abstractCn: 指示质量评估（QE）和自动后期编辑（APE）数据分散在不同的版本中，因此没有单一资源能够全面支持跨任务和语言对的训练与评估。我们将WMT 2020--2024共享任务的谱系与扩展的英语-马拉雅拉姆语资源整合为\indicqe：包含126,754个实例，涵盖九种方向对，每个片段最多对齐四种标签类型，包括直接评估、人工后期编辑、词级OK/BAD标签和错误解释，以及按四个难度维度分层测试集。在此基础上，我们对六种提示式大型语言模型（LLM）和三种COMET指标在片段级QE上进行了基准测试，以及三种系统在APE上的测试。其中两个维度部分基于直接评估，并选择其压缩切片，因此每个维度都与来自同一语言对且具有相同分数分布的控制组进行比较。只有一个维度通过了控制测试：整体和词级质量信号冲突的片段，在所有九种系统和所有七个包含该维度的语言对中，其排名均低于同等分数的同类片段。标注者分歧在没有控制的情况下看似第二难，但在控制下则没有影响。少样本提示的成本对每个模型均不超过3.4B，无论相关性还是输出格式合规性。同语言内的准确率使得不同语言对的分数无法比较：在三种训练指标中，具有最佳同语言相关性的指标在语言对合并时损失最大。基准测试和代码将公开发布。

articles.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Distillation} (SOPD), which combines the long-horizon correction of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with the on-policy advantage of OPD to provide step-level supervision over complete student-generated trajectories. We show that, at different limits of step length, SOPD reduces to SFT or approximates OPD. Compared with SFT, the teacher responses in SOPD are conditioned on student trajectories and therefore align more closely with student-visited states; compared with OPD, SOPD provides longer-horizon corrections rather than fragmented token-level guidance. Across both reasoning and agent tasks, SOPD substantially outperforms conventional SFT and OPD. For example, on ALFWorld, SOPD improves the average success rate by 13.4 points over Vanilla OPD. We hope this work offers a new perspective for future research on distillation methods.
articles.titleCn: 步长式在线策略蒸馏：在线策略蒸馏与监督微调之间的插值
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过学生生成的轨迹对教师模型的logit分布进行对齐。这种方法取得了显著的实证效果，并且通常只需更少的数据即可超越传统的离策略蒸馏。然而，标准的token级OPD只能沿着错误的学生轨迹提供零散的纠正，无法展开完整且正确的修复路径。受此限制的启发，我们提出了\emph{步级策略内蒸馏}（SOPD），它结合了监督微调（SFT）的长时程纠正与OPD的策略内优势，为学生生成的完整轨迹提供步级监督。我们证明，在不同的步长极限下，SOPD会简化为SFT或近似OPD。与SFT相比，SOPD中的教师响应基于学生轨迹，因此更紧密地与学生访问的状态对齐；与OPD相比，SOPD提供长时程纠正，而非零散的token级指导。在推理和智能体任务中，SOPD均显著优于传统的SFT和OPD。例如，在ALFWorld上，SOPD比Vanilla OPD将平均成功率提高了13.4个百分点。我们希望这项工作能为未来蒸馏方法的研究提供新的视角。

articles.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 深度思想对齐：视频推理中的轨迹级潜在蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 用于视频推理的大型多模态模型（LMMs）长期以来一直受到处理大量视觉信息的高计算成本的阻碍。这一困境促使我们将大型模型的推理能力迁移到更小、更高效的模型中。策略性蒸馏（OPD）通过匹配学生生成的轨迹上的输出标记分布提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，视频推理通常依赖于跨多个帧累积的证据。在这种情况下，输出级监督仅捕获通过标记预测表达的信息，并不直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表示。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了潜在-OPD（Latent-OPD），它通过轨迹级潜在蒸馏增强了OPD。具体而言，我们的方法关注每个轨迹的末端位置，隐藏状态有效地总结了累积的视觉证据和推理上下文。此外，我们引入了一种渐进式教师预览策略，将中间到晚期的学生层与越来越深的教师层进行对齐。在六个视频推理基准测试上的实验表明，Latent-OPD始终优于仅输出级的OPD。值得注意的是，这些改进在帧数有限、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的任务中尤为显著。这些结果确立了Latent-OPD作为高效帧视频推理方法的优越性。

articles.title: FTA-Mem: Fact-Time-Affect Anchored Memory for Low-Density Long-Term Dialogue
articles.abstract: Long-term emotional-support agents require memory mechanisms for personalized understanding across sessions. However, emotional-support dialogue is often low-density: turns are incomplete, evidence is scattered, and user states evolve over time. Existing memory methods usually rely on fixed units, such as turn-level notes or session summaries, which may lose details or introduce redundant noise. We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue. FTA-Mem uses Boundary-preserving Window Segmentation (BWS) to form coherent situation fragments, and constructs Fact-Time-Affect Memory Units (FTA Units) that jointly encode factual content, temporal grounding, and affective context. Retrieved units are then synthesized into structured context for answer generation. Experiments on ES-MemEval and LoCoMo show that FTA-Mem improves overall long-term memory question answering across benchmarks with different information-density characteristics. On ES-MemEval, FTA-Mem achieves 0.3871 F1 and 0.6668 BERTScore. Further analysis shows that situation-level FTA construction better balances evidence preservation and construction cost than coarse session-level or overly fine-grained turn-pair construction, providing an effective granularity trade-off for long-term dialogue memory.
articles.titleCn: FTA-Mem：基于事实-时间-情感锚定的低密度长期对话记忆模型
articles.abstractCn: 长期情感支持代理需要记忆机制以实现跨会话的个性化理解。然而，情感支持对话通常密度较低：对话回合不完整，证据分散，用户状态随时间演变。现有记忆方法通常依赖固定单元，如回合级笔记或会话摘要，这可能导致细节丢失或引入冗余噪声。我们提出了FTA-Mem，一种用于低密度长期对话的结构化记忆框架。FTA-Mem采用边界保留窗口分割（BWS）形成连贯的场景片段，并构建事实-时间-情感记忆单元（FTA单元），联合编码事实内容、时间锚定和情感背景。检索到的单元随后被综合为结构化上下文以生成答案。在ES-MemEval和LoCoMo上的实验表明，FTA-Mem在不同信息密度特征基准上提升了整体长期记忆问答性能。在ES-MemEval上，FTA-Mem达到了0.3871的F1值和0.6668的BERTScore。进一步分析显示，场景级FTA构建在证据保留和构建成本之间取得了更好的平衡，优于粗粒度的会话级或过于细粒度的回合对构建，为长期对话记忆提供了有效的粒度权衡。

articles.title: Executable Code Knowledge: Code as a Native, Validation-Carrying Knowledge Representation for AI Coding Agents
articles.abstract: AI coding agents need more than relevant snippets: they need business semantics, validation evidence, relations, and assurance that their context is current. Existing systems usually infer or externalize this knowledge through retrieval, summaries, graphs, rules, or reverse specifications. We investigate a complementary representation in which selected code units directly carry agent-usable knowledge. We introduce Executable Code Knowledge (ECK) and define an Executable Code Knowledge Unit (ECKU) as a source-bound object combining stable identity, semantics, executable behavior, contracts, evidence, relations, provenance, validation state, and a query interface. Our Python prototype supports code-local authoring, manifest export, evidence execution, exact changed-line impact, freshness checking, and agent-facing projections. Across three real Python repositories and 26 controlled patch tasks, direct ECK provides executable test coverage for 11/11 evidence-bearing tasks and exact selectors for 9/11; hiding declared evidence reduces exact recovery to 1/11 (paired exact McNemar p=0.0078). ECK-derived rules recover 11/11 exact selectors, showing that rules are effective delivery artifacts while ECK supplies source binding, validation state, impact, and freshness. Exact changed-line impact matches independently authored labels on all 26 patches (12 unit links; precision, recall, and F1 all 1.000). AST-bounded fingerprints classify 50 positive changes and 17 unrelated same-file controls correctly, whereas static rules snapshots detect none of the 50 stale cases. Model-backed patch-review and cross-layer studies measure projection fidelity rather than independent impact discovery. These results support a hybrid architecture: retrieval for coverage, ECK for source and evidence governance, and projections for delivery.

articles.titleCn: 可执行代码知识：代码作为原生、携带验证的知识表示，用于AI编程代理
articles.abstractCn: AI编程代理需要的不只是相关代码片段，还需要业务语义、验证证据、关联关系以及确保其上下文是最新的保证。现有系统通常通过检索、摘要、图、规则或逆向规范来推断或外化这些知识。我们研究了一种补充性表示方法，其中选定的代码单元直接承载代理可用的知识。我们引入了可执行代码知识（ECK），并将可执行代码知识单元（ECKU）定义为一个与源代码绑定的对象，它结合了稳定的身份、语义、可执行行为、契约、证据、关联关系、来源、验证状态和一个查询接口。我们的Python原型支持代码本地的编写、清单导出、证据执行、精确变更行影响、新鲜度检查以及面向代理的投影。在三个真实的Python代码库和26个受控补丁任务中，直接的ECK为11/11带有证据的任务提供了可执行的测试覆盖率，并为9/11提供了精确的选择器；隐藏声明的证据将精确恢复率降至1/11（配对精确McNemar p=0.0078）。ECK派生的规则恢复了11/11的精确选择器，表明规则是有效的交付工件，而ECK提供了源绑定、验证状态、影响和新鲜度。精确变更行影响与所有26个补丁上独立编写的标签完全匹配（12个单元链接；精确度、召回率和F1值均为1.000）。AST边界指纹正确分类了50个正向变更和17个无关的同一文件控制，而静态规则快照未检测到50个过时的案例。基于模型的补丁审查和跨层研究测量投影保真度，而不是独立的影響发现。这些结果支持一种混合架构：检索用于覆盖，ECK用于源代码和证据治理，投影用于交付。

articles.title: Clause Encounters of the Third Kind: Can LLMs Replace Language Teachers?
articles.abstract: While various organizations now actively encourage LLM use in classrooms, we still lack rigorous, systematic evaluations of how well these models actually perform the fundamental tasks of language pedagogy. This paper examines whether state-of-the-art LLMs can deliver the kind of corrective feedback and methodological explanations that language learners need. The study tests multiple large language models on their ability to identify, correct, and explain common learner mistakes in English, by systematically varying model parameters to investigate how these technical adjustments affect output quality, pedagogical clarity, and consistency, along with using retrieval-augmented generation to query methodological data. The evaluation employs automated metrics (GLEU, BERTScore) but also human expert judgments to capture dimensions that purely computational measures miss: linguistic nuance, cultural sensitivity, and instructional appropriateness. While models demonstrate impressive surface-level correction abilities, their explanations often lack the terminological and domain knowledge that effective language teaching requires, suggesting that current enthusiasm for AI-assisted language learning may be outpacing our understanding of these systems' actual pedagogical competence.
articles.titleCn: 《第三类接触条款：大型语言模型能否取代语言教师？》
articles.abstractCn: 尽管目前许多机构都在积极鼓励在课堂中使用大型语言模型，但我们仍然缺乏对这些模型在语言教学基本任务中实际表现进行严格、系统的评估。本文探讨了最先进的大型语言模型是否能够提供语言学习者所需的纠正反馈和方法学解释。该研究通过系统地改变模型参数，测试了多个大型语言模型在识别、纠正和解释英语学习者常见错误方面的能力，以调查这些技术调整如何影响输出质量、教学清晰度和一致性，并使用检索增强生成来查询方法学数据。评估采用了自动化指标（GLEU、BERTScore），但也结合人类专家判断来捕捉纯粹计算度量所遗漏的维度：语言细微差别、文化敏感性和教学适宜性。虽然模型展示了令人印象深刻的表面级纠正能力，但它们的解释往往缺乏有效语言教学所需的专业术语和领域知识，这表明当前对人工智能辅助语言学习的热情可能已经超过了我们对这些系统实际教学能力的理解。

articles.title: PolyDebate: A Game-Orchestrated Multimodal System for Debate Skills Practice and Evaluation
articles.abstract: Debate is a structured form of persuasive communication that trains argument construction, rebuttal, oral delivery, and audience awareness. These skills are valued in education, language learning, and professional communication. Recent AI debate systems and LLM-based judges have advanced argument generation and debate evaluation, but most remain text-centered and rarely support learners through a complete multimodal practice experience. We introduce PolyDebate, a game-orchestrated multimodal system for English debate practice and evaluation. PolyDebate guides learners through staged one-on-one (1v1) debates with an AI opponent, while skill cards, props, and coins make persuasive strategies explicit and turn practice into a game-like interaction. During each session, the system captures learner speech and visual delivery evidence, generates context-aware opponent responses, and produces rubric-informed stage-level and overall feedback. PolyDebate is available as both an immersive Unity 3D game version and a web platform version that share the same workflow and evaluation services. Four studies covering AI opponent quality, evaluation coverage, AI judge feedback, and user perception show that PolyDebate brings debate interaction, gamified scaffolding, multimodal assessment, and structured feedback together in a practical workflow for debate skills practice. The demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/mHwBG1_8Ebk.
articles.titleCn: PolyDebate：一个用于辩论技能练习与评估的游戏化多模态系统
articles.abstractCn: 辩论是一种结构化的说服性沟通形式，旨在训练论点构建、反驳、口头表达和受众意识等技能。这些技能在教育、语言学习和专业沟通中备受重视。近年来，人工智能辩论系统和基于大型语言模型的裁判系统在论点生成和辩论评估方面取得了进展，但大多数系统仍以文本为中心，很少支持学习者通过完整的跨模态实践体验进行学习。我们介绍了PolyDebate，这是一个用于英语辩论练习和评估的游戏化跨模态系统。PolyDebate引导学习者在与人工智能对手进行分阶段的单人（1v1）辩论中，通过技能卡、道具和金币使说服策略明确化，并将练习转化为游戏化互动。在每次练习中，系统会捕捉学习者的语音和视觉表达证据，生成情境感知的对手回应，并提供基于评分标准的分阶段和整体反馈。PolyDebate提供沉浸式的Unity 3D游戏版本和共享相同工作流程和评估服务的网页平台版本。四项研究涵盖人工智能对手质量、评估覆盖范围、人工智能裁判反馈和用户感知，表明PolyDebate将辩论互动、游戏化支架、跨模态评估和结构化反馈整合在一个实用的辩论技能练习工作流程中。演示视频可在https://youtu.be/mHwBG1_8Ebk查看。

articles.title: Domain-Agnostic Neural Topic Modeling with Contextual Token-Level Semantic Graph Representation
articles.abstract: Recent advances in neural topic models with pre-trained language models (PLMs) have achieved strong performance by leveraging general-domain pre-training, yet their topic interpretability often degrades on specialized corpora. This limitation primarily stems from the geometry of the embedding space, where domain-specific terms unseen during pre-training collapse into an indistinguishable region, and neither domain-specific re-training, word-level graph enrichment, nor parameter-efficient fine-tuning can restructure this space without inheriting the capacity ceiling of the underlying encoder. Our key insight is that a learnable graph layer operating on token-level PLM embeddings can acquire corpus-specific semantic structure that the frozen encoder lacks, because token-level graphs preserve document-local context that word-level representations discard and joint optimization with the topic objective reshapes embedding geometry directly from target-domain evidence. We instantiate this insight as DARTopic, a domain-agnostic framework that constructs token-level semantic graphs from frozen PLM embeddings and jointly trains a GNN encoder with topic inference. Across three benchmarks spanning general, biomedical, and legal domains, DARTopic consistently outperforms strong baselines in topic coherence and document clus- tering without any encoder fine-tuning, while demonstrating robustness to PLM choice and favorable runtime efficiency over fine-tuning based alternatives.
articles.titleCn: 领域无关神经主题模型与上下文标记级语义图表示
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，结合预训练语言模型（PLM）的神经主题模型通过利用通用领域预训练取得了优异的性能，但在专业语料库上的主题可解释性往往下降。这一限制主要源于嵌入空间的几何结构：在预训练阶段未见过的领域特定术语会坍缩到一个无法区分的区域，而领域特定再训练、词级图增强或参数高效的微调都无法重构这一空间，且无法突破底层编码器的容量限制。我们的核心洞察在于，一个作用于词级PLM嵌入的可学习图层能够获取语料库特有的语义结构，这是冻结的编码器所缺乏的，因为词级图保留了文档局部上下文而词级表示会丢弃，且与主题目标的联合优化能直接从目标领域证据重塑嵌入几何结构。我们将这一洞察实例化为DARTopic，这是一个领域无关的框架，它从冻结的PLM嵌入构建词级语义图，并联合训练一个图神经网络编码器与主题推理。在涵盖通用、生物医学和法律领域的三个基准测试中，DARTopic在主题一致性和文档聚类方面始终优于强大的基线模型，且无需编码器微调，同时展现出对PLM选择的鲁棒性和优于基于微调替代方案的有利运行效率。

articles.title: STAIR: Semantic-Temporal Automaton for Interpretable Reasoning in Temporal Question Answering
articles.abstract: By leveraging large-scale pretraining, LLMs can interpret diverse temporal expressions and question formulations without task-specific training. However, existing prompt-based neuro-symbolic systems continue to rely on LLMs for both semantic interpretation and exact temporal inference. Consequently, discrete decisions regarding intervals, time anchors, and ordered states remain vulnerable to probabilistic errors and difficult to verify. We present STAIR, a \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{A}utomaton for \textbf{I}nterpretable \textbf{R}easoning. STAIR separates semantic interpretation from precise temporal inference: an answer-free LLM adapter maps complex question formulations to normalized temporal intents, while a deterministic temporal automaton with finite control and guarded transitions executes the corresponding policies over canonicalized evidence. Following a rule-first design, STAIR resolves standard questions without invoking an LLM and applies semantic adaptation only when the rule path fails to produce an executable intent. This approach reduces free-form reasoning, making temporal decisions verifiable and interpretable. Specifically, guarded execution supports precise point-time containment and before/after selection, while semantic adaptation handles non-exact intervals and time-anchored queries. Across the TimeQA-Easy, TimeQA-Hard, TempReason-L2, and TempReason-L3 datasets, STAIR consistently outperforms strong baselines in the TQA task using matched model settings, achieving average F1 improvements of 16.57\% and 3.10\% when utilizing the Qwen2.5-7B and GPT-4o-mini models, respectively. Furthermore, ablations and diagnostic analyses demonstrate that STAIR excels at handling both boundary-sensitive and order-sensitive queries, while its guarded execution and semantic adaptation ensure precise point-time reasoning and inexact intervals, respectively.
articles.titleCn: STAIR：用于时间问答中可解释推理的语义-时间自动机
articles.abstractCn: 通过利用大规模预训练，大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在无需特定任务训练的情况下解释多样化的时间表达式和问题表述。然而，现有的基于提示的神经符号系统仍然依赖LLMs进行语义解释和精确的时间推理。因此，关于时间间隔、时间锚点和有序状态的离散决策仍然容易受到概率性错误的影响，且难以验证。我们提出了STAIR，一个用于可解释推理的**语义-时间自动机**。STAIR将语义解释与精确的时间推理分离：一个无答案的LLM适配器将复杂的问题表述映射到规范化的时间意图，而一个具有有限控制和受保护转换的确定性时间自动机则对规范化的证据执行相应的策略。遵循规则优先设计，STAIR在不调用LLM的情况下解析标准问题，并且仅在规则路径无法生成可执行意图时才应用语义适配。这种方法减少了自由形式的推理，使时间决策变得可验证和可解释。具体而言，受保护的执行支持精确的点时间包含和先后选择，而语义适配处理非精确的时间间隔和时间锚点查询。在TimeQA-Easy、TimeQA-Hard、TempReason-L2和TempReason-L3数据集上，使用匹配的模型设置，STAIR在TQA任务中始终优于强大的基线，当分别使用Qwen2.5-7B和GPT-4o-mini模型时，平均F1值分别提升了16.57%和3.10%。此外，消融实验和诊断分析表明，STAIR在处理边界敏感和顺序敏感查询方面表现出色，而其受保护的执行和语义适配分别确保了精确的点时间推理和非精确的时间间隔。

articles.title: INSPIRE: A Benchmark for Instruction-Aware Speech Retrieval
articles.abstract: Existing speech retrieval systems rely on fixed similarity matching and cannot adapt to diverse user intents. We introduce INSPIRE, the first benchmark for instruction-aware speech retrieval, in which natural-language instructions dynamically specify relevance criteria, including semantic content, speaker identity, speaking style, environmental sounds, and their combinations. We evaluate four retrieval paradigms: large audio-language models, cascaded pipelines, self-supervised speech models, and contrastive audio-language models. Our results reveal that no current method robustly handles all retrieval intents. Text-based approaches perform relatively better at semantic retrieval but struggle with paralinguistic attributes, while speech-based models are moderately better at capturing acoustic properties but falter at following instructions. These findings highlight the need for unified architectures capable of instruction-aware speech retrieval.
articles.titleCn: INSPIRE：指令感知语音检索基准
articles.abstractCn: 现有的语音检索系统依赖于固定的相似度匹配，无法适应多样化的用户意图。我们引入了INSPIRE，这是首个用于指令感知语音检索的基准，其中自然语言指令动态指定相关性标准，包括语义内容、说话人身份、说话风格、环境声音及其组合。我们评估了四种检索范式：大型音频语言模型、级联流水线、自监督语音模型和对比音频语言模型。我们的结果表明，当前没有哪种方法能够稳健地处理所有检索意图。基于文本的方法在语义检索方面表现相对较好，但在副语言属性方面存在困难，而基于语音的模型在捕捉声学属性方面表现中等，但在遵循指令方面表现不佳。这些发现突出了对能够进行指令感知语音检索的统一架构的需求。

articles.title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents
articles.abstract: LLM agents increasingly answer questions over dynamic raw-document collections, where files may change before preprocessing, and relevant evidence (spans, sections, pages, or tables) is query-dependent. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches pre-materialize evidence via fixed chunking, embeddings, or persistent indexes: effective for lookup, yet costly, stale-prone, and committed to a granularity before the query is known. We formulate in-context search as Budgeted Evidence Localization over a latent evidence space induced by dynamic raw documents and propose LENS (Latent Evidence Exploration and Search), an index-free framework. Instead of pre-materializing the evidence space, LENS maintains a query-conditioned belief over candidate units, iteratively selecting candidates via complementary lexical, local, and exploratory proposal policies, updating the belief via an LLM relevance oracle, and narrowing toward high-posterior regions under a controllable budget. Evidence is consolidated into compact, source-grounded regions of interest and compressed into self-organizing knowledge clusters reused across related queries. On a controlled 500-question evaluation with matched corpus snapshots, LENS reaches 62.4% exact match and 84.8% evidence recall vs. 65.2% exact match but 50.4% evidence recall for a ReAct-style baseline. Across scales, LENS gives the strongest supporting-fact localization and answer grounding. On a fixed 150-question fullwiki subset over the raw Wikipedia dump with zero indexing, LENS and ReAct are nearly tied in official answer quality (43.3% vs. 42.7% EM), with LENS grounding more answers in retrieved evidence (84.0% vs. 70.7%). A no-retrieval Closed-Book reference highlights the contribution of model memory. LENS is query-ready after corpus changes, needs no preprocessing or persistent index, and preserves source-grounded evidence localization throughout.
articles.titleCn: 镜头：通过动态原始文档的潜在证据探索进行情境内搜索
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理越来越多地针对动态原始文档集合回答问题，其中文件可能在预处理前发生变化，而相关证据（如片段、章节、页面或表格）则依赖于查询。现有的检索增强方法通过固定分块、嵌入或持久索引预先构建证据：虽然适用于查找，但成本高昂、易过时，且在查询确定前就固定了粒度。我们将情境搜索表述为在动态原始文档诱导的潜在证据空间上的预算化证据定位，并提出LENS（潜在证据探索与搜索）——一种无索引框架。LENS不预先构建证据空间，而是维持一个查询条件下的候选单元信念，通过互补的词汇、局部和探索性提议策略迭代选择候选，通过LLM相关性预言机更新信念，并在可控预算下收敛到高后验区域。证据被整合为紧凑的、基于来源的兴趣区域，并压缩成自组织的知识簇，供相关查询复用。在一个受控的500个问题的评估中，使用匹配的语料库快照，LENS达到62.4%的精确匹配和84.8%的证据召回率，而ReAct风格的基线为65.2%的精确匹配和50.4%的证据召回率。在各个规模上，LENS提供了最强的支持事实定位和答案基础。在一个固定的150个问题的全维基子集上，使用原始维基百科转储且无索引，LENS和ReAct在官方答案质量上几乎持平（43.3% vs. 42.7% EM），但LENS在检索证据中定位了更多答案（84.0% vs. 70.7%）。一个无检索的闭卷参考突出了模型记忆的贡献。LENS在语料库变化后即可准备就绪，无需预处理或持久索引，并始终保留基于来源的证据定位。

articles.title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use external memory systems to support personalization by drawing on long and evolving interaction histories, in which user preferences may be distributed across time, change with context, and conflict with earlier evidence. However, existing systems face three limitations: fixed-turn, fixed-token, or session-based boundaries can mix unrelated dialogue or split an event from its causes, decisions, and outcomes; storing multiple pieces of user information from the same interaction as a single memory binds together items that serve different functions and should be independently retrievable; and treating the current task as a single top-$k$ retrieval query can return fragments that are individually relevant but fail to jointly capture preference evolution, temporal validity, and contextual applicability. We introduce \textsc{QUMem}, a structured memory framework for query-conditioned user-state inference. \textsc{QUMem} first segments interaction histories into variable-length episodes according to semantic continuity, then decomposes each episode into independently retrievable factual, preference, and transferable insight memories while preserving temporal positions and source evidence. At inference time, three sequential agents identify task-specific information needs, plan multi-query retrieval over the typed memory stores, and jointly infer a temporally and contextually valid user state for downstream response generation. \textsc{QUMem} achieves state-of-the-art performance on both PersonaMem and KnowU-Bench, demonstrating the effectiveness of query-conditioned user-state inference for long-term personalization.
articles.titleCn: QUMem：面向查询条件用户状态推理的LLM代理个性化记忆
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地使用外部记忆系统来支持个性化，通过利用长期且不断发展的交互历史，其中用户偏好可能随时间分布、随上下文变化并与早期证据冲突。然而，现有系统存在三个局限性：固定的回合、固定标记或基于会话的边界可能会混合不相关的对话或将事件与其原因、决策和结果分割开来；将同一交互中的多个用户信息片段存储为单个记忆会绑定不同功能的条目，而这些条目应独立检索；将当前任务视为单个top-$k$检索查询可能会返回单个相关但未能联合捕捉偏好演变、时间有效性和上下文适用性的片段。我们引入\textsc{QUMem}，这是一个用于查询条件用户状态推理的结构化记忆框架。\textsc{QUMem}首先根据语义连续性将交互历史分割为可变长度的片段，然后将每个片段分解为可独立检索的事实、偏好和可迁移见解记忆，同时保留时间位置和来源证据。在推理时，三个顺序代理识别特定任务的信息需求，规划对类型化记忆存储的多查询检索，并联合推断出用于下游响应生成的、在时间和上下文中有效的用户状态。\textsc{QUMem}在PersonaMem和KnowU-Bench上均实现了最先进的性能，证明了查询条件用户状态推理对于长期个性化有效性的有效性。

articles.title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory
articles.abstract: As agentic tasks grow in complexity, LLM agents increasingly rely on experiential memory to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks. Effective memory design must jointly address what to store, how memory is structured and retrieved, and how memory evolves. Existing systems tackle each only partially: they store trajectories, insights, or workflows as isolated entries, discarding compositional relationships among subtasks and reusable skills; retrieve by flat embedding similarity that ignores relational signals; and maintain memory without leveraging its relational structure. We propose HyperSkill, a hypergraph-based memory framework that jointly improves all three. HyperSkill represents memory as a hypergraph with two node types, subtask steps and reusable skills, where each hyperedge links the subtasks and skills from a single trajectory. Dual-path retrieval queries both subtask and trajectory levels, ranking skills by co-occurrence across retrieved trajectories. Periodic structure-informed maintenance prunes low-utility nodes and merges redundant skills via quality-weighted propagation. Across xBench, GAIA, and WebWalkerQA with GPT-4o and Qwen3-30B-A3B, HyperSkill outperforms ten memory baselines, yielding gains of up to +11.51 on GAIA and +11.18 on WebWalkerQA.
articles.titleCn: 超技能：基于超图结构技能记忆的自进化大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 随着代理任务的复杂性增加，LLM代理越来越依赖经验记忆来跨任务重用程序性知识。有效的记忆设计必须同时解决存储什么、记忆如何结构化和检索，以及记忆如何演变的问题。现有系统仅部分地处理这些问题：它们将轨迹、见解或工作流作为独立的条目进行存储，丢弃子任务和可重用技能之间的组合关系；通过忽略关系信号的扁平嵌入相似性进行检索；并且在不利用其关系结构的情况下维护记忆。我们提出了HyperSkill，这是一个基于超图的记忆框架，它同时改进了这三个方面。HyperSkill将记忆表示为一个包含两种节点类型——子任务步骤和可重用技能——的超图，其中每个超边链接来自单个轨迹的子任务和技能。双路径检索查询子任务和轨迹级别，通过检索轨迹中的共现对技能进行排序。周期性结构化维护通过质量加权传播修剪低效用节点，并合并冗余技能。在xBench、GAIA和WebWalkerQA（使用GPT-4o和Qwen3-30B-A3B）上，HyperSkill优于十个记忆基线，在GAIA上实现了高达+11.51的增益，在WebWalkerQA上实现了高达+11.18的增益。

articles.title: The Commercial Tax: Rent-vs-Own Blind Spots in Multi-Hop Retrieval Benchmarks
articles.abstract: Enterprises connect language models to their own data through retrieval. The benchmarks that rank multi-hop retrieval systems leave out two facts a buyer needs before a published number can be used: whether the retrieval backbone may be deployed commercially, and what it costs to build. On licensing: the field's dense-retrieval anchor, NV-Embed-v2, is licensed cc-by-nc-4.0. Of the four leading MuSiQue systems we audit (HippoRAG-2, PropRAG, SAG, KET-RAG), three depend on it for their best numbers and none says so. On performance: we measure thirteen embedders from eight makers on one identical MuSiQue harness with bootstrap confidence intervals throughout. Until mid-2026 there was a real commercial tax: the best commercially-licensed embedder trailed the anchor by 2.31 Recall@5 points (95% CI [0.91, 3.71], p=0.001). NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Embed-8B, released 2026-07-16, has closed it: +0.24 at Recall@5 (95% CI [-0.94, +1.43], p=0.69), -0.58 at Recall@10 (p=0.28). It matches the anchor, does not beat it, and is the only entrant that is commercially licensed, free to self-host, and indistinguishable from the anchor; every other entrant meeting the first two conditions sits 5.2 to 14.6 points below. The durable finding is the paid-versus-free divide: API embedders charge per token on every re-index, self-hosted ones charge nothing. On cost: three of five audited systems (adding Microsoft's GraphRAG) do not disclose indexing cost, and the only published GraphRAG dollar figures span 11x inside one third-party paper (USD 2.30 vs USD 24.94 to index a 5.64 MB corpus once); extrapolated to 1 TB that undisclosed choice separates roughly USD 428K from $4.6M. Our cost model keeps one-time embedding apart from recurring answering: at 1 TB, embedding sits 7.5x-900x below graph construction, and a year of answering at 10,000 queries/day sits 350x or more below it.

articles.titleCn: 商业税：多跳检索基准中的租购盲点
articles.abstractCn: 企业通过检索将语言模型连接到自身数据。排名多跳检索系统的基准测试遗漏了买家在采用发布数据前需要了解的两个事实：检索骨干是否可以商业化部署，以及构建成本。关于许可：该领域的密集检索锚点NV-Embed-v2采用cc-by-nc-4.0许可。在我们审计的四家领先MuSiQue系统（HippoRAG-2、PropRAG、SAG、KET-RAG）中，有三家依赖它获得最佳性能，但均未明确说明。关于性能：我们使用同一MuSiQue测试框架对八家厂商的十三款嵌入器进行测试，全程采用引导置信区间。截至2026年中期，存在真实的商业差距：最佳商业化许可嵌入器在Recall@5上落后锚点2.31分（95% CI [0.91, 3.71], p=0.001）。NVIDIA于2026年7月16日发布的Nemotron-3-Embed-8B弥补了这一差距：Recall@5提升0.24分（95% CI [-0.94, +1.43], p=0.69），Recall@10下降0.58分（p=0.28）。它追平了锚点，未超越，且是唯一商业化许可、可自由自托管且与锚点无差异的进入者；其他满足前两个条件的进入者均落后5.2至14.6分。持久的发现是付费与免费之间的差距：API嵌入器按每次重新索引的token收费，自托管嵌入器则不收费。关于成本：五家审计系统中有三家（新增Microsoft的GraphRAG）未披露索引成本，唯一公开的GraphRAG美元数据在一篇第三方论文中跨度达11倍（索引5.64 MB语料库一次成本为2.30美元 vs 24.94美元）；若推算至1 TB，这一未披露选择将使成本差异从约42.8万美元至460万美元。我们的成本模型将一次性嵌入与持续问答分开：在1 TB规模下，嵌入成本比图构建低7.5至900倍，而每天10,000个查询的问答成本则比图构建低350倍以上。

articles.title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval
articles.abstract: Pseudo-query generation can alleviate the supervision bottleneck for agent skill retrieval, but existing document-level approaches typically leave the rich internal relations among capabilities, parameters, and usage examples implicit. As a result, generated queries may be topically relevant to a skill while lacking capability grounding and parameter consistency, raising the question of whether explicitly exploiting a skill document's internal structure can produce more effective retrieval signals. We therefore propose Skill2Query, a framework that first parses a skill document into a Skill Knowledge Graph and then generates pseudo-queries through a three-stage process including style mimicking, query template generation, and parameter filling. The generated queries can be used for offline index augmentation, online query expansion, and retriever training. Four benchmarks (TheoremQA, LogicBench, ToolQA, and CHAMP) are used to evaluate Skill2Query with large-scale skill candidate pools across multiple downstream applications, including skill retrieval, retriever training, and end-to-end agent execution. Using nearly 30K skills across diverse domains, we generate 700K category-diverse pseudo-queries. Skill2Query consistently improves sparse, dense, and skill-routing retrieval, with an average Recall@1 gain of 6.70 percentage points across retrieval settings. Skill2Query-generated training data also achieves the best Recall@1 and nDCG@1 among the evaluated generation baselines. Further evaluations with multiple LLM backends demonstrate that improved skill retrieval translates into higher agent task success rates. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query.
articles.titleCn: Skill2Query：利用技能结构生成代理技能检索的伪查询
articles.abstractCn: 伪查询生成可以缓解代理技能检索的监督瓶颈，但现有的文档级方法通常将能力、参数和使用示例之间丰富的内部关系隐式化。因此，生成的查询可能与技能主题相关，但缺乏能力基础和参数一致性，引发了是否明确利用技能文档的内部结构能否产生更有效的检索信号的问题。为此，我们提出了Skill2Query框架，该框架首先将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱，然后通过包含风格模仿、查询模板生成和参数填充的三阶段过程生成伪查询。生成的查询可用于离线索引增强、在线查询扩展和检索器训练。我们使用四个基准（TheoremQA、LogicBench、ToolQA和CHAMP）在多个下游应用中使用大规模技能候选池评估Skill2Query，包括技能检索、检索器训练和端到端代理执行。使用近30K个跨不同领域的技能，我们生成了700K类别的多样化伪查询。Skill2Query始终提高了稀疏、密集和技能路由检索，在检索设置中平均提升了6.70个百分点的Recall@1。Skill2Query生成的训练数据在评估的生成基线中实现了最佳的Recall@1和nDCG@1。进一步使用多个LLM后端进行的评估表明，改进的技能检索转化为更高的代理任务成功率。代码和资源可在https://github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query获取。

articles.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization), a primal-dual method that combines pool-based rewrites with adaptive constraint weighting to optimize system prompts under explicit operational constraints. Across agentic benchmarks, CAPO more reliably reaches empirically feasible operating points while improving task performance. CAPO also generalizes beyond agentic settings, achieving strong results on assistant-style evaluations with output-format and safety/privacy constraints. We further introduce DCAPO (Dynamically Trained CAPO), which trains a feedback- and dual-conditioned rewriter with pool-based GRPO while keeping the task agent frozen. Across task agents of different sizes, DCAPO produces a feasible prompt in every evaluated domain and matches or improves the task accuracy achieved by the evaluated baselines. A surrogate analysis characterizes how finite-pool and discrete-rewrite errors enter the inexact primal-dual procedure.
articles.titleCn: 约束感知提示优化：面向大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被部署为依赖系统提示来使用工具并完成任务代理。此类部署提出了独特的操作要求，包括适当的工具使用、简洁的提示和解决方案路径，以及遵守安全和格式政策。然而，对于许多从业者而言，收集特定领域的监督数据来对模型进行后训练以满足这些要求是不可行的。我们介绍了CAPO（约束感知提示优化），这是一种结合了基于池的重写和自适应约束加权的主-对偶方法，用于在明确操作约束下优化系统提示。在代理基准测试中，CAPO更可靠地达到经验上可行的操作点，同时提高了任务性能。CAPO还超越了代理设置，在具有输出格式和安全/隐私约束的助手风格评估中取得了优异成果。我们进一步引入了DCAPO（动态训练的CAPO），它使用基于池的GRPO训练一个反馈和双条件重写器，同时保持任务代理冻结。在不同规模的任务代理中，DCAPO在所有评估的领域中都生成了可行的提示，并匹配或改进了评估基线达到的任务准确率。一个替代分析描述了有限池和离散重写错误如何进入不精确的主-对偶程序。

articles.title: DuplexGen: Decoupling Content, Timing, and Acoustics for Synthetic Dialogue Speech
articles.abstract: Synthetic conversational speech has become an important resource for developing and evaluating conversational speech systems. However, existing dialogue synthesis pipelines typically generate dialogue content first and then insert interruptions, overlap, and backchannels using handcrafted markers or timing rules, making conversational timing prescribed rather than interaction-driven. We present DuplexGen, a dialogue synthesis framework that explicitly decouples content, timing, and acoustics. An LLM first generates the dialogue script, and then two full-duplex conversational models perform the script while listening to each other in real time. This allows conversational timing to emerge naturally while preserving the scripted content. Finally, a high-fidelity text-to-speech model re-renders the interaction without altering its timing. As a demonstration of the proposed framework, we construct a patient--clinician conversational speech corpus with construction-time annotations, including word timestamps, speaker activity, overlap regions, and interaction events. Experimental results show that the proposed framework produces conversational dynamics closer to real dialogue than conventional stitching-based synthesis.
articles.titleCn: 双工生成模型：解耦内容、时序和声学特征用于合成对话语音
articles.abstractCn: 合成对话语音已成为开发和评估对话语音系统的重要资源。然而，现有的对话合成流程通常先生成对话内容，再使用手工标记或时序规则插入打断、重叠和反馈，使得对话时序成为预设而非交互驱动的。我们提出了DuplexGen，一个明确将内容、时序和声学分离的对话合成框架。首先，大型语言模型生成对话脚本，然后两个全双工对话模型在实时互相倾听的情况下执行脚本。这允许对话时序自然涌现，同时保留脚本内容。最后，一个高保真文本到语音模型重新渲染交互，而不改变其时序。为展示所提出的框架，我们构建了一个带有构建时标注的患者-临床医生对话语音语料库，包括单词时间戳、说话人活动、重叠区域和交互事件。实验结果表明，所提出的框架生成的对话动态比传统的基于拼接的合成更接近真实对话。

articles.title: Coverage Is Not Containment: A Fundamental Limit of Admission-Time Defenses Against Coordinated Poisoning of Vector Retrieval
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers a question by retrieving passages from a vector store and trusting them as context, so anyone who can add documents can try to steer the answer. A recent, appealing defense filters poisoning at ingestion, rejecting any document that behaves like a hub. We show it -- and every ingestion-time filter -- is defeated by a coordinated adversary that injects a handful of individually unremarkable documents which together surround one target query and seize its top-k (on BGE-large / BEIR, m=10 documents take 10/10; 9.9/10 on a live HNSW index). The attack is not theoretical. Realized as ordinary fluent text and run end-to-end through a BGE-large + HNSW + Qwen2.5-7B pipeline, it makes the generator emit the attacker's planted claim in 88% of targets, versus 0% without the injection. And no admission-time defense stops it: at ingestion an attack cone is geometrically identical to a legitimate niche upload, so -- measuring this directly -- the strongest trained classifier, given every feature and thousands of examples, separates the two no better than chance, catching 4.2% of attacks at a 1% false-positive rate. We prove this limit for the entire class of ingestion-time statistics (any decision from documents and reference queries alone), and it reproduces -- and worsens -- across two corpora and five encoders. The one signal that separates an attack from legitimate niche ingestion -- a query's demand -- is invisible before retrieval, which is also the escape: a retrieval-time detector that observes demand catches 100% of the attacks at the same 1% false-positive rate. Coverage of the query space by an admission gate is not containment of coordinated poisoning; robust defense must move past the front door, to demand.
articles.titleCn: 覆盖率不等于控制：针对向量检索的协同中毒攻击，基于入站时间防御的基本局限性
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过从向量存储中检索段落并将其作为上下文来回答问题，因此任何能够添加文档的人都可以尝试引导答案。最近，一种吸引人的防御方法是在摄入时过滤中毒，拒绝任何行为像中心节点的文档。我们展示了它——以及所有摄入时过滤器——都被一个协调的对手击败，该对手注入少量单独不起眼的文档，这些文档共同围绕一个目标查询并占据其前k（在BGE-large / BEIR上，m=10的文档占10/10；在实时HNSW索引上为9.9/10）。这种攻击并非理论上的。实现为普通的流畅文本，并通过BGE-large + HNSW + Qwen2.5-7B管道端到端运行，它在88%的目标中使生成器发出攻击者植入的主张，而没有注入时则为0%。并且没有承认时防御能阻止它：在摄入时，攻击锥与合法的利基上传在几何上完全相同，因此——直接测量——最强的训练分类器，给定所有特征和数千个示例，区分两者的效果不比随机猜测更好，在1%的假阳性率下捕获了4.2%的攻击。我们证明了整个摄入时统计类的这个极限（仅基于文档和参考查询的任何决策），它在两个语料库和五个编码器上重现——并且更糟。区分攻击和合法利基摄入的唯一信号是查询的需求，但在检索之前是不可见的，这也是逃脱的方法：一个观察需求的检索时检测器在相同的1%假阳性率下捕获了100%的攻击。承认门对查询空间的覆盖不是协同中毒的遏制；稳健的防御必须超越前门，转向需求。

articles.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
articles.abstract: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.
articles.comment: Code is available at https://github.com/NineAbyss/R-3-Bench . The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/R-3-Bench/R-3-Bench
articles.titleCn: $R^3$-Bench：在共享预算下，大型语言模型难以进行资源合理推理
articles.abstractCn: 在认知科学中，资源理性探讨智能体应如何分配有限的计算资源以最大化预期价值。大多数推理和智能体基准测试采用独立于任务的预算；现有的共享预算研究未能将套件性能与同一模型的单问题能力表现进行校准。我们引入了$R^3$-Bench，该基准测试在无工具和代理环境下，对数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理中的六问题套件进行评估，并采用共享预算。匹配的单问题响应曲线定义了一个基于观察成功的离线经验式预言机。在六种模型的72个主表格单元中，预言机的平均值在所有单元中均等于或超过竞赛平均值，并在71个单元中严格更高。在适度的无工具压力下，等量分配重放也对六种模型中的四种超过了竞赛表现。轨迹诊断揭示了策略更新有限和压力相关的失败模式。在强代理压力下的三种模型诊断中，至少有一个固定调度器在九个单元中的六个单元中超过了竞赛平均值，但没有任何策略在所有领域占主导地位。这些结果表明，在已证明的能力和共享预算实现之间存在着持续的差距。

articles.title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Scene Rearrangement
articles.abstract: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided placement in 3D scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement families and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Each instruction must be resolved into a valid new placement position. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, our evaluation inserts a prediction into the scene, recomputes relations, and tests relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified naturalized rewrite. After fine-tuning, LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, and PlaceIt3D produce valid placements for 68.3%, 31.6%, and 22.4% of instructions, respectively. Across models, relation satisfaction surpasses physical validity, relations such as nearest and between are the most difficult, and phrasing has minimal effect on performance.

articles.titleCn: ReRef-3D：一个用于空间指代表达引导的3D场景重排的基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了ReRef-3D，一个用于语言引导三维场景放置的基准。它包含998个基于CLEVR的场景，共计33,826条指令，涵盖了16种放置类别以及直接、单跳和双跳引用。每条指令都必须解析为一个有效的新的放置位置。由于指令定义的是可接受放置的区域而非单一坐标，我们的评估将预测插入场景中，重新计算关系，并测试关系满足度和物理有效性。每条指令还包括一个经过验证的自然化重写。在微调后，LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM和PlaceIt3D分别对68.3%、31.6%和22.4%的指令生成了有效放置。在所有模型中，关系满足度超过了物理有效性，最近和之间等关系最为困难，而措辞对性能的影响最小。

articles.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
articles.abstract: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.

articles.titleCn: 先验审计-修复上下文转换将LLM验证器阈值调向宽容
articles.abstractCn: 自动化检查流程越来越多地将一种语言模型作为检查器，而将另一种（或相同的）模型作为修正器。我们探究这种连接方式是否会影响检查器报告的内容。通过对当前任务保持字节完全一致，在人类验证正确的ProcessBench轨迹上测量误报率，我们发现模型上下文中已完成的审计→修复事件在15种模型措辞组合中均降低了误报率，相较于长度匹配的非审计对照组，降低了2.8至11.5个百分点，相对减少了9%至25%。这一方向与累积信息文献的预测相悖：审计报告错误的某个事件会进一步降低误报率，在所有五个措辞组合中，该操作能完美落地，尽管负向不对称性预测会标记更多错误。分解该事件发现，修复内容和审计裁决是互补的：不同组件对不同模型系列产生效果。信号检测分析将变化定位在阈值而非辨别力上——标准在15种组合中均发生变化，并在13种情况下得到纠正，而d'值无一生还，尽管d'测试在设计上敏感度减半——对50次误报的手工审计发现82%是简单的错误，因此在当前操作点，这种转变未必有害。启用推理后，该效应在两个测试模型上保持相对大小，阈值读数也保持不变。

articles.title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before the final answer. We propose RUPA (Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents), a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents. RUPA represents an execution history as a directed trajectory graph in which reasoning states, tool interactions, and environment feedback are nodes connected by temporal and semantic dependency edges. It then propagates uncertainty over this graph to capture how execution risk accumulates and transfers across interaction steps. The propagated signal is combined with trajectory-level behavioral features and goal-alignment information to produce a confidence estimate for the full agent trajectory. We evaluate RUPA on representative agent benchmarks, including $τ$-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA, using 6 open-source LLMs spanning multiple model families. Experimental results show that RUPA consistently outperforms existing UQ methods by providing more accurate uncertainty estimates, enabling earlier failure detection, and improving uncertainty-guided agent execution across diverse agent tasks. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling relational dependency is crucial to reliable UQ for long-horizon LLM agents, providing a practical foundation for trustworthy agent execution.
articles.titleCn: 从序列到结构：关系不确定性传播用于大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的鲁棒性不确定性量化（UQ）对于在复杂交互环境中部署大型语言模型（LLM）智能体至关重要。现有的UQ方法主要依赖于局部信号，例如标记概率、预测熵或每步置信度，因此忽略了在执行轨迹中通过长距离依赖关系累积的错误。结果，它们可能无法识别那些原因在最终答案之前的推理或交互步骤中产生的智能体故障。我们提出了RUPA（智能体关系不确定性传播），这是一个针对LLM智能体的轨迹级UQ框架。RUPA将执行历史表示为一个有向轨迹图，其中推理状态、工具交互和环境反馈通过时间语义依赖边连接成节点。然后，它在这个图上传播不确定性，以捕捉执行风险如何在交互步骤中累积和转移。传播的信号与轨迹级行为特征和目标对齐信息相结合，为整个智能体轨迹生成置信度估计。我们在代表性的智能体基准测试上评估了RUPA，包括τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2和GAIA，使用了6个跨多个模型系列的开放源LLM。实验结果表明，RUPA通过提供更准确的不确定性估计、实现更早的故障检测以及改进不确定性指导的智能体执行，在多样化的智能体任务中始终优于现有的UQ方法。这些结果证明，显式建模关系依赖性对于长时程LLM智能体的可靠UQ至关重要，为可信智能体执行提供了实用基础。

articles.title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards
articles.abstract: Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5% and reverse on 8.5%. Yet on both corpora the resulting model leaderboards are bit-identical: Kendall tau = 1.00 with zero of six models displaced. That invariance is far weaker evidence than it looks, and we quantify how weak. Switching pools moves a model's win rate by 1.9pp (SD), one adjacent pair in our own leaderboard sits 0.8pp apart and had a 38% chance of swapping, and an item-level bootstrap displaces at least one model in 28% of resamples. The observed zero is the common outcome, not a property of aggregation: on the same measured perturbation, a ten-model leaderboard is displaced with probability 0.86 and a twenty-model leaderboard with probability 0.9997. Reporting a six-model leaderboard is safe; the safety does not generalise, and everything that consumes labels per item is not safe at any size. We make the distinction precise, show that a widely used dataset's stated assumption of no intra-group annotator variability is false, and show that an LLM judge tracks the crowd pool over the expert pool on all three models we test, including one from a different vendor. All code, per-call outputs, and pre-registered decision rules will be released upon acceptance.

articles.titleCn: 谁的黄金？标注者池在项目级别上的分歧很大，并且被小排行榜隐藏了
articles.abstractCn: 偏好基准是通过雇佣标注员建立的，而标注员的身份被视为实现细节。我们衡量了这一细节带来的价值。在2,885个MultiPref项目中，当两个池子内部都达成一致时（即完全无需参考平局打破规则），专家标注员和众包标注员分别对23.6%的项目赋予不同的多数标签，并在9.2%的项目中命名相反的获胜者；在246个类似一致性的MT-Bench单元中，基准作者和招募的专家在30.5%的项目上意见不一，并在8.5%的项目中反转结果。然而，在这两个语料库中，最终生成的模型排行榜是完全一致的：肯德尔tau系数为1.00，没有模型被移动。这种不变性远不如表面看起来那样有说服力，我们量化了其薄弱程度。切换池子会使模型的胜率变化1.9个百分点（标准差），我们排行榜中相邻的一对模型相差0.8个百分点，且存在38%的概率会互换位置，而项目级别的自助法在28%的重采样中至少移动一个模型。观察到的零结果是常见情况，而非聚合属性：在相同的测量扰动下，一个十模型排行榜被移动的概率为0.86，而一个二十模型排行榜被移动的概率为0.9997。报告一个六模型排行榜是安全的；这种安全性不具有普遍性，并且任何按项目消耗标签的操作在任何规模下都不安全。我们明确了这一区别，表明一个广泛使用的数据集所声明的无组内标注员变异性的假设是错误的，并表明我们测试的三个模型中，包括一个来自不同供应商的模型，大型语言模型裁判器在所有三个模型上跟踪众包池而非专家池。所有代码、每次调用的输出和预先注册的决策规则将在接受后公开。

articles.title: A Scalable Pipeline for LLM-Teacher Distillation Labeling: Work-Stealing Job Scheduling and Memory-Aware GPU Concurrency
articles.abstract: Labeling large text corpora with LLM teachers has become a practical route to training data at scale. At millions of items, hand-labeling every batch is not feasible, and two questions dominate: what label quality a teacher buys per dollar, and how to keep a fleet of GPU workers busy under skewed, failure-prone workloads. We present a simple, reproducible pipeline that addresses both. First, a work-stealing ring pool: each worker owns a queue, drains it first, and then steals from ring successors, with exactly-once task claims via atomic conditional writes and crash tolerance via stale-claim sweeping. The claim protocol requires only a compare-and-set primitive from its storage layer; we implement it on a single SQLite file, which makes the reference implementation dependency-free and the experiments reproducible on one machine. Second, a memory-aware concurrency rule that sizes per-node parallelism by how many model copies fit on the GPU, so the same code runs safely across device sizes. Third, a relabeling benchmark methodology in which the teacher relabels a public dataset that already has gold labels, so quality reduces to an agreement measurement and cost follows from measured throughput. Under skewed load the pool sustains up to 3.4 times the throughput of static sharding while matching it at zero skew, loses 0 of 2,000 tasks when half the workers are killed mid-run (static sharding loses 953), and yields measured quality and cost points for an instruction-tuned teacher on irony and sentiment tasks. All experiments run on public data and commodity hardware; code, tests, and run logs are released.

articles.titleCn: 一种用于LLM-教师蒸馏标注的可扩展流水线：工作窃取任务调度和内存感知GPU并发
articles.abstractCn: 使用大型语言模型教师对大规模文本语料库进行标注已成为一种实用的训练数据获取途径。在数百万条数据项的情况下，手动标注每一批数据并不可行，因此主要面临两个问题：教师每花费一美元能获得何种标签质量，以及如何在倾斜且易出故障的工作负载下保持GPU工作集群的忙碌状态。我们提出了一种简单且可复现的流程，同时解决了这两个问题。首先，一个工作窃取环形池：每个工作节点拥有一个队列，首先清空该队列，然后从环形后继节点窃取任务，通过原子条件写入实现精确一次任务声明，并通过陈旧声明清理实现容错性。声明协议仅需其存储层提供的比较并设置原语；我们在单个SQLite文件上实现它，这使得参考实现无依赖性，并且实验可以在一台机器上复现。其次，一个基于内存感知的并发规则，通过GPU上可容纳的模型副本数量来调整每个节点的并行度，从而确保相同代码在不同设备尺寸上安全运行。第三，一个重新标注基准方法，其中教师重新标注一个已包含黄金标签的公共数据集，因此质量简化为一致性测量，成本则根据测量的吞吐量得出。在倾斜负载下，该池的吞吐量可达静态分片的三倍多，同时在零倾斜时与之匹配，当一半工作节点在运行中途被杀死时，仅丢失2,000个任务中的0个（静态分片会丢失953个），并为指令调优的教师在对讽刺和情感任务进行标注时提供了测量的质量和成本点。所有实验均在公共数据和商用硬件上运行；代码、测试和运行日志均已发布。
